AIGEN_grade5_ac9d619e-11af-4125-8dc6-083.q: During a cricket match, Arjun and Kabir scored runs in the ratio 4:5. After the match, the coach told them, "Together you both scored 108 runs!" Kabir then said, "I scored more than Arjun." By how many runs did Kabir outscore Arjun?

So Kabir outscored Arjun by 12 runs!
